decision_rationale: The paper presents Pro2RNA as a multimodal reverse-translation language model and explicitly says it uses a generative RNA language model for autoregressive mRNA sequence generation. It also reports large-scale training on 1M protein-mRNA pairs across 241 bacterial species and 0.55M pairs across 13 eukaryotic species, supporting foundation-model-like scale and transferability.
evidence_snippet: “generative RNA language model for mRNA codon-level sequence generation”; “autoregressive generation of mRNA sequences”; trained on “approximately 1 million protein-mRNA pairs from 241 bacterial species” and “0.55 million pairs from 13 eukaryotic species”,
